rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Grandiflora.
Registration name: AROyqueli
Exhibition name: Gold Medal
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, 1982).
Introduced in United States by Armstrong Nursery as 'Gold Medal'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow, copper shading, ages to cream . Mild, fruity, spice, tea fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea, high-centered to cupped, reflexed bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, long sepals buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns, upright, well-branched. Large, semi-glossy, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 30" to 6' (75 to 185cm). Width: 3' (90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, garden or specimen. Hardy. heat tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
